# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rest after picking apples and reflect on how much their lives and community are changing as they grow older and prepare to leave for college. On her walk home from the post office, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and feels a new tension between them when he holds her hand on the bridge. She returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to comfort [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before slipping away to [Victoria Island](../codex/places.md#victoria-island) to escape her troubles in daydreaming.

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) hosts a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, presenting them with tokens of appreciation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is annoyed by Gilbert's sentimental remark during supper and accepts Charlie Sloane's escort home, which leaves her regretting her choice. The following evening, after receiving well-meaning but discouraging comments from local women about attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) takes a long walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) through the woods where they find a wild apple tree and rekindle their comfortable companionship.

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Ada](../character/ada.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Hannah](../character/hannah.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after an emotional farewell, traveling by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arrival, she is met at the station by [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who cheers her up on the way to their new boarding house.

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), feeling intimidated by the unfamiliar environment and student crowd. Later, they visit Old St. John's Cemetery to unwind and encounter [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a friendly and talkative fellow student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). The three girls quickly bond as [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) opens up about her indecisiveness, home, and college life.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors, [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), her indecisiveness, and her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Before parting ways, they discover the grave of a midshipman from the War of 1812, which moves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Phil's charm and frivolity compared to [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), aided by Philippa Gordon's social popularity, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gains status after leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives her first batch of letters from home, including updates from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), as well as a note from [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) revealing that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been writing to her.

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk together in the park, enjoying the autumn scenery and discussing life. Afterward, they walk along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.

## Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. She is warmly welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she comforts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a bedtime confession. Over the holidays, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from friends, visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enjoys reuniting with her loved ones.

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — While spending the night in Anne's room, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) unexpectedly delivers a marriage proposal on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) declines the unromantic offer, and [Jane](../character/jane.md) accepts the refusal with slight coldness, noting [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely move on to [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md). After [Jane](../character/jane.md) departs the next morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) laughs at the absurdity of her first proposal by proxy, though she feels disappointed that her romantic dreams were crushed by such a unromantic reality.

## Chapter X Patty’s Place

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her second term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while dealing with an unwanted marriage proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) suggesting they rent a house together in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) for the upcoming school year with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as their housekeeper. After searching in vain for a suitable house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spot a 'To Let' sign on Patty's Place.

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place to inquire about renting the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her genuine love for the property, Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) agrees to rent it to them for their requested amount so she and [Maria](../character/maria.md) can travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). Later, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits the girls and enthusiastically begs to join their living arrangements for the coming school year.

## Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Timothy Cotton](../character/timothy-cotton.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Herb Spencer](../character/herb-spencer.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her new story, "Averil's Atonement," with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), both of whom offer varying critiques. After finishing the manuscript, she submits it to two different publications, but receives rejections from both. Disheartened by the experience, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and give up her literary ambitions.

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Cottons, [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's strict instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) drags [Dora](../character/dora.md) away from [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the Cotton children. After returning home, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) during dinner to cover up his disobedience, which leaves him feeling guilty. Later that night, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses his misdeeds to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who helps comfort him and explains the concept of conscience.

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her reluctance to leave the earthly life she loves. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers gentle comfort and reflects deeply on life's true purpose as she walks home. The following night, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community to mourn her and reflect on her memory.

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) secretly submitted her rejected story to a baking powder contest with added ad plugs, which won first prize. Though horrified by the story's degradation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted slightly by Gilbert's practical perspective after weeping over the situation.

## Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [William Blair](../character/william-blair.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Ada](../character/ada.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into [Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) explains her relaxed philosophy on chaperoning the girls, while her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat, settle into the house. [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) the cat tries to assert dominance over the newcomers, resulting in a swift defeat by the Sarah-cat and ongoing skirmishes with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) until they eventually become friends. The household chats about house duties and past cat mishaps.

## Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), Boulters, [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md)** — As snow begins to fall, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) returns from grocery shopping and discusses household expenses with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), which details recent misadventures and funny incidents back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds herself feeling lonely while trying to navigate uncomfortable moments during Gilbert's visits. [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in conversations about books, improper language, and town gossip. After Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) brings the mail, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has passed away and left her a thousand dollars, guaranteeing her financial ability to continue at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on turning twenty while talking with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) in the living room. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs dressed for a dance, prompting a lighthearted conversation about beauty, marriage, and potential suitors before she departs. After [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) leaves, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a brief moment reflecting on Phil's eccentric personality.

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — After chatting with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) at Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes out to the orchard where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finds her and proposes. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his romantic suit, insisting she only sees him as a friend. Left heart-broken and awkward, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retreats to her room to weep over the ruined friendship.

## Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — During her pleasant visit to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the small yellow house where she was born and learns more about her parents from the current resident. The woman hands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads reverently after visiting their grave. Reading the letters makes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feel truly connected to her parents for the first time in her life.

## Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sits reminiscing by the fire at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives home unexpected and a day early from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). After a joyful reunion, [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts into the kitchen to excitedly greet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and talk about his lost tooth, echoes, and his future marriage plans.

## Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) despite feeling a lonely ache from Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. She spends time with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) confronts the reality of growing up and leaving childhood imaginings behind. Later, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), gently warning her that they were meant for each other.

## Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Lilly](../character/lilly.md), [Uncle Mark](../character/uncle-mark.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), Columbia, Redmond College, [God](../character/god.md)** — Philippa writes a long letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) describing her summer spent at Cousin Emily's boarding house. She humorously introduces the eccentric fellow boarders and relates how she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a divinity student. Though she tries to deny her feelings because he is ugly and serious, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits by the end of her letter that she has fallen in love with him.

## Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take a walk in the park on a windy autumn day, reflecting on her changing relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When her umbrella breaks in a sudden rainstorm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares shelter and walks her back to Patty's Place. That evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her friends.

## Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), Patty’s Place, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Redmond College, [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) prepare at Patty's Place for a [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is frequently seen with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After leaving the house with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception and spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.

## Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — As April examinations approach, the girls at Patty's Place prepare for their studies and learn that Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) will remain abroad for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a evening walk in the park, where she joyfully reveals that she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife in the slums, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her ideal romance with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and her lingering thoughts of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carson](../character/carson.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) on the doorstep about local gossip, school, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wanders to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), contemplating her complicated feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), as well as her sadness about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) moving away after marriage.

## Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding day at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their long friendship as [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) heads down to marry [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then walks with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) into the parlor and later through Lovers' Lane, where they talk about their past, their mutual acquaintances, and Anne's upcoming summer plans.

## Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gets a ride to her new boarding house with Mrs. Amelia [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is delivering the mail in place of her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories about her romantic choices, her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), and her cousin [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), before dropping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off at [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet's home, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — In a letter to Philippa, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her new boarding situation at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes the charmingly peculiar home, her hostess's background, and the local characters including a taciturn hired boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also teases that she is observing another local elderly love affair, though she vows not to meddle this time.

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends a prayer meeting with [Janet](../character/janet.md) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and observes [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who offers to walk [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Janet](../character/janet.md) visit the Douglas home for tea, where they spend time with John's mother, who speaks about her failing health and her son's future marriage.

## Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Janet](../character/janet.md) crying on her twentieth birthday over John Douglas's failure to propose despite courting her for twenty years. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show some spirit, [Janet](../character/janet.md) rejects John's offer to walk her home after prayer meeting. However, seeing John's stricken reaction, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) panics, chases him down, and restores the couple back together, leaving [Janet](../character/janet.md) right back where she started.

## Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Samuel](../character/samuel.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a blunt and unwanted marriage proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, [Alec](../character/alec.md) summons [Janet](../character/janet.md) to the Douglas home because old Mrs. Douglas is dying. Following her death, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and explains he was forced by his mother's deathbed vow to keep their agreement secret for nineteen years, leading [Janet](../character/janet.md) to forgive the late woman and accept his proposal.

## Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), chatting and laughing with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as they unpack. Later in the semester, during a rainy evening, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares melodramatic stories written during her school days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives good news when her short story is accepted for publication, which raises her literary spirits. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive a day early on Friday, surprising the household and causing a flustered, humorous interaction before Roy's friendly sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — As their final examinations come to an end, the girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) reflect on what their four years at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) have taught them. For [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) and the graduation dance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's gifted lilies-of-the-valley and pink enamel heart pendant instead of Roy's violets. However, after [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), a hurt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) snaps the necklace, turns [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) down for a dance, and masks her heartbreak during the night's festivities.

## Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends pack and reflect on their time at Patty's Place as their [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) years end. [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the harbor pavilion, but to her own surprise, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. Returning home in distress, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses what happened to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who scolds her at first before offering comfort.

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Simon Fletcher](../character/simon-fletcher.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disappointed and lonely after breaking off her relationship with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She catches up on local news with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), learns about Jane's upcoming marriage to a rich man, attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after the birth of her baby boy.

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), [George Fletcher](../character/george-fletcher.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is devastated to learn that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. During a painful night of worry, she realizes her true, deep love for him. At dawn, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) passes by with the news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover, filling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with immense joy and relief.

## Chapter 43

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk with him to Hester Gray's garden, but she has to decline to prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next day, they go on their walk together to the old garden, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. She accepts him, and they clarify past misunderstandings about [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) before walking home together engaged.
